major_findings.evidence: The benchmark.json headline with_skill pass_rate=1.0 for two stages does not reconcile with the per-case grading.json that it claims to aggregate (tasks 8.2/9.2 require '42 graded runs aggregate to one benchmark per skill'). Triangulated by direct check + two independent sub-audits: 3 with_skill runs diverge — diagnose case-2 (benchmark 6/6=1.0 vs grading 5/6=0.833), diagnose case-3 (benchmark 6/6=1.0 vs grading 4/6=0.667), verify case-1 (benchmark 6/6=1.0 vs grading 5/6=0.833). Same model output is graded twice (case-* tree vs eval-* tree; response.txt byte-identical e.g. diagnose case-3 sha d65f2c80… in both) and the benchmark adopts the favorable eval-* grade. These are exactly the 2 workspaces whose grader_run_status.json shows exit_code:1/is_error:true (diagnose wall_seconds=14/outputTokens=187; verify wall_seconds=477), i.e. the grader did not complete cleanly yet a 1.0 benchmark was finalized. The masked grade hides real execution defects the per-case grader verified=True: diagnose case-3 emitted route_to=S1/verdict=return_upstream AND a RAW output-contract violation ('prose preamble and a markdown fence' instead of a pure JSON handoff envelope). Root cause is the dclaude grader 402 (see route_limitations) forcing a gclaude grader rescue that produced a more lenient verdict; the retained per-case grading is the stricter/honest one. (Nuance: S4 contract line 39 permits S4→S1 only when G1/G3 genuinely fail input validation, and the verify case-1 divergence appears partly a grader text-keying artifact (expectation passed=null), so the substantive defect centers on diagnose case-3; regardless, the benchmark-vs-42-grading reconciliation requirement is not met for 2/7 stages.)
major_findings.required_change: Reconcile benchmark.json to the canonical per-case grading.json for the 3 over-reported runs (or re-grade all 42 with one authoritative grader and document which tree is canonical); never finalize a benchmark while grader_run_status is is_error:true — regenerate after a clean grader run; and fix the S4 case-3 execution defects the optimistic grade masked (enforce clean JSON output with no prose/markdown fence, and confirm route_to=S1 is only emitted when G1/G3 input validation genuinely fails per contract §2, else revise_here→S4/blocked→S4).

minor_findings.evidence: The shared envelope does not mechanically enforce two contract invariants that S4 already enforces via if/then: (a) rubric_results entries allow failure_action=null and route_to=null even when passed=false (contract §0 requires both when failed); (b) input_validation.status=fail does not force positive_artifact=null (contract: no fabricated positive artifact on input-validation failure). These are contract-enforced in prose only.
minor_findings.required_change: Add if/then conditionals (passed=false ⇒ failure_action/route_to non-null; input_validation.status=fail ⇒ positive_artifact null) to match the schema-enforcement standard S4 already sets.

minor_findings.evidence: Asymmetry with S4: mastery_judgment.status='mastered' is not schema-enforced against weak multidimensional evidence (e.g. transfer=fail/delayed_retention=not_executed) — the mastery-threshold rule relies on the G7 rubric/contract only, whereas S4 enforces tested_mastered⇒hint level none|low at schema level. Also load.current_model_version has minimum:1, so the required load object cannot represent a cold-start 'no prior model' state (handled by routing to S4, but the field creates a modeling edge).
minor_findings.required_change: Consider a schema-level link preventing mastered without supporting multidim evidence (or document why it must remain rubric-only); allow current_model_version=0 or a sentinel for cold-start in the load object.
